# Made-in-China.com

> > Made-in-China.com is a leading B2B marketplace connecting global buyers with Chinese manufacturers across industrial equipment, electronics, packaging, textiles, and specialized technology products.

The platform features verified suppliers from key manufacturing regions including Zhejiang, Liaoning, and Jiangsu provinces, offering product catalogs spanning water treatment systems, fiber optic cables, industrial drones, packaging solutions, and textile materials. Manufacturers showcase their capabilities through detailed product listings with online trading features.

## Key Topics

- China manufacturers
- B2B marketplace
- Water purifiers and ice makers
- Fiber optic cables (ADSS, tactical, hybrid)
- Industrial and agricultural drones
- Packaging solutions (pet food bags, PP woven)
- Textile yarn products
- Ningbo and Zhejiang suppliers
- Shenyang and Liaoning manufacturers
- Product catalogs and online trading
- Water treatment equipment
- Outdoor and tactical cables
- RC and commercial drones
- Food packaging materials
- Core spun and acrylic yarn
